QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: state
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: PN-ENG state (0=INACTIVE, 1=GATE REJECT, 2=GUIDING, 3=TERMINAL, 4=RECOVER)

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: range
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Slant range to target

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: horizRange
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Horizontal range to target; the quantity the entry gate tests

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: closingSpeed
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Closing speed along line of sight, positive when closing

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: losBearing
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Line-of-sight bearing to target, 0 = North, clockwise positive

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: losElevation
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Line-of-sight depression below horizon, positive down

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: timeToImpact
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Estimated time to intercept

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: uMag
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Specific thrust magnitude being demanded

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: uMin
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Authority floor at the current speed; uMag below this loses control margin

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: collectivePred
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Predicted normalised collective; approaching zero means the motors are clipping

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: tilt
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Predicted thrust-axis tilt from vertical (thrust axis, not pitch attitude)

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: vHoriz
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Horizontal speed

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: vDesEff
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Effective commanded closing speed after entry ramp and VRS guard

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: valid
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: 1 if the target solution is valid this cycle

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: gatePass
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: 1 if the entry gate was satisfied; 0 also means unknown, never assume passed

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: committed
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: 1 once the terminal freeze has latched inside PNE_R_MIN

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: authorityExceeded
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: 1 if the authority floor exceeds what the airframe can produce

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: vrsGuardActive
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: 1 while the vortex-ring-state guard is attenuating the descent command

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: clampLat
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: 1 while the PN command is clamped by PNE_MAX_G

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: clampTilt
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: 1 while the thrust-axis tilt is clamped by PNE_TILT_MAX

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: clampUmag
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: 1 while the authority floor is scaling the command up
